### Made Lower to Be Crowned with Glory
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/made-lower-to-be-crowned-with-glory
Passage: Hebrews 2:5-9
Points:
- God subjected the coming world to Jesus rather than to angels.
- Humanity fell from its original ruling commission over creation through sin.
- Jesus became human and was made lower than angels to taste death for everyone.
- Through His suffering and resurrection, Christ is now crowned with glory and honor.
- United with Christ, redeemed humanity shares in an exalted dignity above the angels.
